title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`. You may assume each input has exactly one solution.

testCases.description: pair not involving the first element

hints.text: Try every pair of indices and check whether their values sum to the target.
Use a hash map from value to index so each lookup is O(1) instead of scanning again.
For each number x, check whether target - x was already seen; if so, return the stored index and the current one.

solution.explanation: Single pass with a hash map storing value -> index.
